Description: ShelfSense ECS, IoT, SQS and SNS

ImageUri.Description: Immutable ECR image URI with digest or release tag

ApiCertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate ARN for the public API

ApiDomainName.Description: DNS name covered by the ACM certificate

MongoSecretArn.Description: Secrets Manager ARN containing the Atlas URI

SigningSecretArn.Description: Secrets Manager ARN containing event HMAC key

ApiAuthSecretArn.Description: Secrets Manager ARN containing API token key

InventoryMaxTasks.Description: Set to 1 for fixed baseline and 4 for scaling experiment

AlertEmail.Description: Optional email for SNS cold chain alerts
